modules.summary: Deterministic oscillator and ADSR envelope primitives for Web Audio authoring.

A seeded coast as a pure function: bar, surf zone, cusped sand, dunes, headlands, cliffs and rocks in five kinds and five sands, with the footprints people left on it. Stands alone, or joins a sea from generative/ocean by handing it its ground. Deterministic and renderer-free.
Draws a generative/boats fleet for keel/lit as one instanced hull per kind, and hands render/ocean-render the casters and wakes that put each boat in the water's reflections and white water.

A seeded fleet on any sea: dinghies, fishing boats and sloops that sail, swing at anchor or sit beached until the tide lifts them, each pose a pure function of seed and time and floating on the sea's own waves, with their hulls as plain triangles. Deterministic and renderer-free.

Rare, seeded animal life: 42 species that cast by region (each region led by its own locals, in their local coats and names), world and season, each animal with its own seeded build, pace and nerve, idle through a Markov matrix of actions, act together in joint scenes, climb trees and fly, posed each frame as capsule parts any renderer can draw. Sky flocks and planes included. Deterministic and renderer-free.
Deterministic seed-and-token traits for replayable Flash editions.
Fixed-timestep animation clock with explicit FPS and bounded catch-up.

Scoped, removable keyboard-command map for artwork documents.

A seeded lo-fi score that grows with a tree: rootless jazz chords on felt keys, a dusty kit, bass, a kalimba leitmotif per species, vinyl crackle, tape wow, rain, wind, birds and crickets. Tone.js is injected.

Seeded ocean life: a school that parts round the shark following it and jellies carried by the waves, each animal a pure function of seed and time, posed as capsule parts any renderer can draw. Deterministic and renderer-free.
Seeded 2D value noise with smooth interpolation and fractal octaves.

A sea as a pure function: seeded Gerstner waves on real dispersion, the seabed, currents, the moon's tide and how light dies with depth. Everything that floats, swims or draws asks the same waves. Deterministic and renderer-free.

Draws a sea for keel/lit from above or inside it: moving Gerstner surface, Snell's window, seabed, caustics, light shafts and marine snow as a depth pass over any scene, plus a swarm that draws any number of animals as near bodies and far instances cut from them.
Framework-free orbit-camera position and perspective matrix helpers.

/** Compact palette parsing, interpolation, and deterministic selection. MIT. */
/** Color channels as [red, green, blue, alpha], each 0 to 255. Alpha may be omitted. */
export type ColorChannels = readonly number[];
/**
 * Parses a #rrggbb or #rrggbbaa hex color into channel values.
 *
 * @param value Hex color string; case-insensitive.
 * @returns [red, green, blue, alpha], each 0 to 255; alpha defaults to 255.
 * @throws TypeError when the string is not a valid hex color.
 */
export declare function parseHexColor(value: string): number[];
/**
 * Formats channel values as a CSS rgba() string.
 *
 * @param color [red, green, blue, alpha] channels; missing channels are treated as 255.
 * @returns The rgba() string with alpha scaled to 0 to 1.
 */
export declare function rgba(color: ColorChannels): string;
/**
 * Linearly interpolates two colors channel by channel.
 *
 * @param left Start color; missing channels are treated as 255.
 * @param right End color; missing channels are treated as 255.
 * @param amount Interpolation factor, clamped to [0, 1].
 * @returns A four-channel color of rounded values.
 */
export declare function mixColors(left: ColorChannels, right: ColorChannels, amount: number): number[];
/**
 * Selects a palette entry by index, wrapping negative and overflow indexes.
 *
 * @param palette Non-empty array of hex color strings.
 * @param index Any integer; it wraps modulo the palette length.
 * @returns The parsed [red, green, blue, alpha] channels of the entry.
 * @throws RangeError when the palette is empty or not an array.
 * @throws TypeError when the selected entry is not a valid hex color.
 */
export declare function paletteColor(palette: readonly string[], index: number): number[];

/** Deterministic xoshiro128** helpers for replayable browser art. MIT. */
/** A deterministic generator returning values in [0, 1). */
export type SeededRandom = () => number;
/**
 * Folds a hex seed string into four unsigned 32-bit state words.
 *
 * The seed is stripped of an optional 0x prefix, padded with "0" to 64 hex
 * characters, and truncated to 64. Each word xors an early 8-character
 * slice with a late one.
 *
 * @param hexSeed Hex string, with or without a 0x prefix.
 * @returns Four unsigned 32-bit words.
 */
export declare function seedWords(hexSeed: string): [number, number, number, number];
/**
 * Creates a xoshiro128** generator seeded from a hex string.
 *
 * An all-zero seed is nudged to a nonzero state so the stream never
 * degenerates. The same seed always produces the same sequence.
 *
 * @param hexSeed Hex string, with or without a 0x prefix.
 * @returns A function producing deterministic values in [0, 1).
 */
export declare function createSeededRandom(hexSeed: string): SeededRandom;
/**
 * Draws a uniform integer from an inclusive range.
 *
 * @param random The injected generator, typically from {@link createSeededRandom}.
 * @param minimum Inclusive lower bound; must be a safe integer.
 * @param maximum Inclusive upper bound; must be a safe integer of at least minimum.
 * @returns An integer between minimum and maximum inclusive.
 * @throws RangeError when the bounds are not a valid safe-integer range.
 */
export declare function randomInt(random: SeededRandom, minimum: number, maximum: number): number;

fields.label: Internode budget
fields.help: More internodes make a finer crown and cost more to grow and draw.

modules.summary: Self-organizing tree growth over a whole lifespan: light-driven branching, pipe-model thickening, yearly bloom, leaf and fall, slow dieback and shed limbs. Deterministic and renderer-free.

fields.label: Parts
fields.help: Feature switches as a plugin string, for example "-roots,-litter". Parts: roots, leaves, flowers, fruit, deadwood, litter, snow, fallers, sway, shadows, crownShade, bark, sprays, clumps, rootSink, rootBreak.

fields.label: Forest card distance
fields.help: Past this distance from the camera, forest trees draw as impostor cards.

modules.summary: Trees as objects for keel/lit: draws a tree-growth branch graph with surface roots, fluttering leaf blades, flowers and fruit that ripen and fall, litter, snow and one shared wind field, every part behind a feature switch. Also a background forest: baked variants instanced with GPU seasons, swapped for dithered impostor cards past a distance.
Cached byte, text, JSON, and image views over a host-injected verified resolver.

fields.label: Pixel size
fields.help: CSS pixels per art pixel. 0 picks one from the frame size.

fields.label: Shadow lift
fields.help: Raises the darkest tones toward a cool blue, so night never crushes to black.

fields.label: Clump
fields.help: Gathers sub-pixel speckle into masses of one tone, so foliage reads and does not shimmer.

fields.label: Hue ramps
fields.help: Lights lean warm and shadows cool, as pixel artists paint ramps.

fields.label: Glitch
fields.help: Signal bursts that tear rows and drop blocks of the frame. Timed by setTime.

fields.label: Palette
fields.help: Up to 32 colors. When set, every pixel is one of them.

fields.label: Spot inks
fields.help: Up to 4 colors beside the palette. A pixel takes one only when it is already clearly of that hue and is not sky.

fields.label: Sky push
fields.help: Pushes a light far band's saturation, so a fixed palette finds its blue instead of greys. Night skies are left alone.

modules.summary: Dithered voxel pixel art for keel/lit stages: integer pixel grids, depth-banded dither screens, palettes, outlines and cel light.
The light of a real place and instant: sun and moon from a small almanac, sky colours by sun height, season, climate and weather moods, haze, fog and god-ray settings.

Themes for a small floating world: gold, gem, stone, lava, ice, chrome, tech, synth, hologram, glitter and cosmic planters and nature, city, synthwave, vaporwave, crystal, cosmic and voxel worlds, with rare tree skins rolled by rarity, each resolved by a seed into its own variant, and a signal glitch rolled separately for the platform, tree and background, with a full glitch of all three the rarest.
